svg.text: ENTERPRISE AI INFRASTRUCTURE · LONG-CONTEXT POSITIONAL ENCODING & MLA ROPE (#371)
RoPE vs. Dynamic NTK vs. YaRN Temperature vs. MLA Decoupled RoPE
Decoupling a 64-Dim Shared RoPE Key From 512-Dim Latent c_KV Unlocks Matrix Absorption & 99.1% 128K Recall
Why Naive RoPE Breaks 128K & Latent Compression
• Linear PI (theta/s) crushes high-frequency adjacent token resolution
• 128K attention softmax entropy dilution flattens needle logits
• Position-dependent R_m between W_Q and W_UK prevents MLA
matrix absorption (would blow up KV Cache by 7x in HBM!)
Tier 4: MLA Decoupled RoPE + YaRN Temperature
• Splits Key into 512-dim NoPE Latent c_KV + 64-dim Shared RoPE k_R
• W_UK is absorbed directly into W_Q during Decode (576 elems/tok)
• YaRN ramp function + mscale = 0.1*ln(s)+1 sharpens 128K attention
• 99.1% 128K NIAH Recall & 3.55x Smaller KV Cache Than GQA-8
4-Tier Positional Encoding & KV Scaling Matrix (8K -> 128K 16x Extension)
Tier 1 (Linear PI / Unscaled RoPE): 128K NIAH = 14.5% | 4K Retain = 86.2% | KV/Tok/L = 2048 | Absorb = No
Tier 2 (Dynamic NTK-Aware Base) : 128K NIAH = 78.4% | 4K Retain = 97.5% | KV/Tok/L = 2048 | Absorb = No
Tier 3 (YaRN Piecewise + mscale) : 128K NIAH = 98.2% | 4K Retain = 99.4% | KV/Tok/L = 2048 | Absorb = No
Tier 4 (MLA Decoupled RoPE + YaRN): 128K NIAH = 99.1% | 4K Retain = 99.6% | KV/Tok/L = 576 | Absorb = Yes
